description: This file implements the ClientCertIdentity class and related functions for managing client certificate identities, including private key acquisition, setting intermediates, and sorting identities based on validity and expiration.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentity
classes.description: Represents a client certificate identity with methods for private key management and setting intermediates.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentitySorter
classes.description: Provides comparison logic for sorting client certificate identities based on validity, expiration, issuance time, and chain length.

methods.name: IdentityOwningPrivateKeyCallback
methods.description: Callback function that runs when the private key is available, passing it to the provided callback.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentity::SelfOwningAcquirePrivateKey
methods.description: Static method to acquire the private key for a client certificate identity, managing its lifetime.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentity::SetIntermediates
methods.description: Sets intermediate certificates for the identity, allowing UTF-8 in PrintableStrings.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentitySorter::operator()
methods.description: Comparison operator to sort identities based on validity, expiration, issuance time, and chain length.
